name: SigninLogs
description: Azure AD sign-in logs for interactive user authentications. Ref: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/reference/tables/signinlogs

fields.name: TimeGenerated
fields.description: The timestamp (UTC) of the sign-in event. Raw: TimeGenerated (datetime). Conversion: datetime → INT64 epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: AADTenantId
fields.description: The Azure AD tenant ID. Raw: AADTenantId (string).

fields.name: Agent
fields.description: Agentic property for sign-in logs; includes agentType and parentAppId when type is AgenticInstance. Raw: Agent (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint.

fields.name: AlternateSignInName
fields.description: The identification the user provided to sign in; may be UPN or other identifiers. Raw: AlternateSignInName (string).

fields.name: AppDisplayName
fields.description: The application name displayed in the Azure Portal. Raw: AppDisplayName (string).

fields.name: AppId
fields.description: The application identifier in Azure Active Directory. Raw: AppId (string).

fields.name: AppliedConditionalAccessPolicies
fields.description: Applied conditional access policies. Raw: AppliedConditionalAccessPolicies (string).

fields.name: AppliedEventListeners
fields.description: Detailed info about listeners (Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions) triggered by the sign-in event. Raw: AppliedEventListeners (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint.

fields.name: AppOwnerTenantId
fields.description: The tenant identifier of the owner of the application in Azure AD. Raw: AppOwnerTenantId (string).

fields.name: AuthenticationAppDeviceDetails
fields.description: App and device state used during the most recent authentication step using an authentication app. Raw: AuthenticationAppDeviceDetails (string).

fields.name: AuthenticationAppPolicyEvaluationDetails
fields.description: Policies applied and enforced related to the authentication app during the latest sign-in step. Raw: AuthenticationAppPolicyEvaluationDetails (string).

fields.name: AuthenticationContextClassReferences
fields.description: Conditional access authentication contexts applied to the sign-in. Raw: AuthenticationContextClassReferences (string).

fields.name: AuthenticationDetails
fields.description: Result of the authentication attempt and additional details on the authentication method. Raw: AuthenticationDetails (string).

fields.name: AuthenticationMethodsUsed
fields.description: Authentication methods used. Possible values: SMS, Authenticator App, App Verification code, Password, FIDO, PTA, or PHS. Raw: AuthenticationMethodsUsed (string).

fields.name: AuthenticationProcessingDetails
fields.description: Additional authentication processing details, such as agent name for PTA/PHS or server name for federated auth. Raw: AuthenticationProcessingDetails (string).

fields.name: AuthenticationProtocol
fields.description: Protocol type or grant type used. Possible values: none, oAuth2, ropc, wsFederation, saml20, deviceCode. Raw: AuthenticationProtocol (string).

fields.name: AuthenticationRequirement
fields.description: Highest level of authentication needed through all sign-in steps for sign-in to succeed. Raw: AuthenticationRequirement (string).

fields.name: AuthenticationRequirementPolicies
fields.description: Sources of authentication requirement: conditional access, per-user MFA, identity protection, security defaults. Raw: AuthenticationRequirementPolicies (string).

fields.name: AuthenticatorAppLocation
fields.description: The location of the authenticator app. Raw: AuthenticatorAppLocation (string).

fields.name: AutonomousSystemNumber
fields.description: The Autonomous System Number (ASN) of the network used by the actor. Raw: AutonomousSystemNumber (string).

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Log category. Raw: Category (string).

fields.name: ClientAppUsed
fields.description: Legacy client used for sign-in (e.g. Browser, Exchange ActiveSync, IMAP, MAPI, SMTP, POP). Raw: ClientAppUsed (string).

fields.name: ClientCredentialType
fields.description: Type of client credential used (e.g. client assertion, client secret). Raw: ClientCredentialType (string).

fields.name: ConditionalAccessAudiences
fields.description: The audiences targeted by the conditional access policy. Raw: ConditionalAccessAudiences (string).

fields.name: ConditionalAccessPolicies
fields.description: List of conditional access policies triggered by the sign-in activity. Raw: ConditionalAccessPolicies (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint.

fields.name: ConditionalAccessStatus
fields.description: Status of triggered conditional access policy. Possible values: success, failure, notApplied. Raw: ConditionalAccessStatus (string).

fields.name: CorrelationId
fields.description: Identifier sent from the client when sign-in is initiated; used for troubleshooting. Raw: CorrelationId (string).

fields.name: CreatedDateTime
fields.description: Date and time the sign-in was initiated (UTC). Raw: CreatedDateTime (datetime). Conversion: datetime → INT64 epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: CrossTenantAccessType
fields.description: Type of cross-tenant access used by the actor to access the resource. Raw: CrossTenantAccessType (string).

fields.name: DeviceDetail
fields.description: Device information from where the sign-in occurred (deviceId, OS, browser). Raw: DeviceDetail (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint.

fields.name: DurationMs
fields.description: Duration of the sign-in in milliseconds. Raw: DurationMs (long). Conversion: long → INT64.

fields.name: FederatedCredentialId
fields.description: Federated Credential Id. Raw: FederatedCredentialId (string).

fields.name: FlaggedForReview
fields.description: Whether a user flagged a failed sign-in for tenant admin review. Raw: FlaggedForReview (bool).

fields.name: GlobalSecureAccessIpAddress
fields.description: Global Secure Access IP address that user signed in from. Raw: GlobalSecureAccessIpAddress (string).

fields.name: HomeTenantId
fields.description: Tenant identifier of the user initiating the sign-in. Not applicable for Managed Identity or service principal. Raw: HomeTenantId (string).

fields.name: HomeTenantName
fields.description: Tenant name of the external tenant who homes the entity acting in the customer's tenant. Raw: HomeTenantName (string).

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Identifier representing the sign-in activity. Raw: Id (string).

fields.name: Identity
fields.description: Display name of the actor identified in the sign-in. Raw: Identity (string).

fields.name: IncomingTokenType
fields.description: Type of token used to sign in (e.g. primary refresh token, SAML assertion). Raw: IncomingTokenType (string).

fields.name: IPAddress
fields.description: IP address of the client from where the sign-in occurred. Raw: IPAddress (string).

fields.name: IPAddressFromResourceProvider
fields.description: IP address a user used to reach a resource provider; used for Conditional Access compliance. Raw: IPAddressFromResourceProvider (string).

fields.name: IsInteractive
fields.description: Whether the sign-in is interactive (user provides an auth factor) vs non-interactive (client uses token/code). Raw: IsInteractive (bool).

fields.name: IsRisky
fields.description: Whether the sign-in is considered risky. Raw: IsRisky (bool).

fields.name: IsTenantRestricted
fields.description: Whether the sign-in is under a tenant restrictions policy. Raw: IsTenantRestricted (bool).

fields.name: IsThroughGlobalSecureAccess
fields.description: Whether the user came through Global Secure Access service. Raw: IsThroughGlobalSecureAccess (bool).

fields.name: Level
fields.description: Log level. Raw: Level (string).

fields.name: Location
fields.description: 2-letter country code from where the sign-in occurred. Raw: Location (string).

fields.name: LocationDetails
fields.description: City, state, country/region and lat/long of the sign-in location. Raw: LocationDetails (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint.

fields.name: MfaDetail
fields.description: MFA detail (deprecated). Raw: MfaDetail (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint.

fields.name: NetworkLocationDetails
fields.description: Network location details including the type of network used and its names. Raw: NetworkLocationDetails (string).

fields.name: OperationName
fields.description: Operation name. Raw: OperationName (string).

fields.name: OperationVersion
fields.description: Operation version. Raw: OperationVersion (string).

fields.name: OriginalRequestId
fields.description: Request identifier of the first request in the authentication sequence. Raw: OriginalRequestId (string).

fields.name: OriginalTransferMethod
fields.description: Transfer method used to initiate a session throughout all subsequent requests. Raw: OriginalTransferMethod (string).

fields.name: ProcessingTimeInMilliseconds
fields.description: Processing time in milliseconds. Raw: ProcessingTimeInMilliseconds (string).

fields.name: Resource
fields.description: Resource. Raw: Resource (string).

fields.name: ResourceDisplayName
fields.description: Name of the resource that the user signed in to. Raw: ResourceDisplayName (string).

fields.name: ResourceGroup
fields.description: Resource group. Raw: ResourceGroup (string).

fields.name: ResourceId
fields.description: Identifier of the resource that the user signed in to. Raw: ResourceId (string).

fields.name: ResourceIdentity
fields.description: The resource that the user signed in to. Raw: ResourceIdentity (string).

fields.name: ResourceOwnerTenantId
fields.description: Tenant identifier of the owner of the resource referenced in the sign-in. Raw: ResourceOwnerTenantId (string).

fields.name: ResourceProvider
fields.description: Resource provider. Raw: ResourceProvider (string).

fields.name: ResourceServicePrincipalId
fields.description: Identifier of the service principal representing the target resource. Raw: ResourceServicePrincipalId (string).

fields.name: ResourceTenantId
fields.description: Tenant identifier of the resource referenced in the sign-in. Raw: ResourceTenantId (string).

fields.name: ResultDescription
fields.description: Error message or reason for failure of the sign-in activity. Raw: ResultDescription (string).

fields.name: ResultSignature
fields.description: Result signature. Raw: ResultSignature (string).

fields.name: ResultType
fields.description: 5-6 digit error code for the sign-in event; 0 indicates success. Raw: ResultType (string).

fields.name: RiskDetail
fields.description: Reason behind the state of a risky user/sign-in. Possible values: none, adminGeneratedTemporaryPassword, userPerformedSecuredPasswordChange, etc. Raw: RiskDetail (string).

fields.name: RiskEventTypes
fields.description: Risk event types (deprecated). Raw: RiskEventTypes (string).

fields.name: RiskEventTypes_V2
fields.description: Risk event types for the sign-in. Possible values: unlikelyTravel, anonymizedIPAddress, maliciousIPAddress, etc. Raw: RiskEventTypes_V2 (string).

fields.name: RiskLevel
fields.description: Risk level. Raw: RiskLevel (string).

fields.name: RiskLevelAggregated
fields.description: Aggregated risk level. Possible values: none, low, medium, high, hidden. Raw: RiskLevelAggregated (string).

fields.name: RiskLevelDuringSignIn
fields.description: Risk level during sign-in. Possible values: none, low, medium, high, hidden. Raw: RiskLevelDuringSignIn (string).

fields.name: RiskState
fields.description: Risk state. Possible values: none, confirmedSafe, remediated, dismissed, atRisk, confirmedCompromised. Raw: RiskState (string).

fields.name: ServicePrincipalId
fields.description: Application identifier used for sign-in; populated when signing in using an application. Raw: ServicePrincipalId (string).

fields.name: ServicePrincipalName
fields.description: Application name used for sign-in; populated when signing in using an application. Raw: ServicePrincipalName (string).

fields.name: SessionId
fields.description: Session ID generated during the sign-in. Raw: SessionId (string).

fields.name: SessionLifetimePolicies
fields.description: Conditional access session management policies applied during the sign-in event. Raw: SessionLifetimePolicies (string).

fields.name: SignInIdentifier
fields.description: The identification the user provided to sign in; may be UPN or other identifiers. Raw: SignInIdentifier (string).

fields.name: SignInIdentifierType
fields.description: Type of sign-in identifier. Possible values: userPrincipalName, phoneNumber, proxyAddress, qrCode, onPremisesUserPrincipalName. Raw: SignInIdentifierType (string).

fields.name: SourceAppClientId
fields.description: The Source App's Client ID for Target Identities. Raw: SourceAppClientId (string).

fields.name: SourceSystem
fields.description: Type of agent the event was collected by (e.g. OpsManager, Linux, Azure). Raw: SourceSystem (string).

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Sign-in status including error code and description of the error for failures. Raw: Status (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint.

fields.name: TokenIssuerName
fields.description: Name of the identity provider (e.g. sts.microsoft.com). Raw: TokenIssuerName (string).

fields.name: TokenIssuerType
fields.description: Type of identity provider. Possible values: AzureAD, ADFederationServices, AzureADBackupAuth, etc. Raw: TokenIssuerType (string).

fields.name: TokenProtectionStatusDetails
fields.description: Whether the sign-in token was bound to the device via token protection. Raw: TokenProtectionStatusDetails (dynamic). Conversion: dynamic → UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The name of the table. Raw: Type (string).

fields.name: UniqueTokenIdentifier
fields.description: Base64 encoded request identifier to track tokens issued by Azure AD as they are redeemed. Raw: UniqueTokenIdentifier (string).

fields.name: UserAgent
fields.description: User agent information related to sign-in. Raw: UserAgent (string).

fields.name: UserDisplayName
fields.description: Display name of the user. Raw: UserDisplayName (string).

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: Identifier of the user. Raw: UserId (string).

fields.name: UserPrincipalName
fields.description: The UPN of the user. Raw: UserPrincipalName (string).

fields.name: UserType
fields.description: Whether the user is a member or guest in the tenant. Possible values: member, guest. Raw: UserType (string).
